history.summary: A well-known marble Ram-Sita temple set in a large, well-maintained garden in Bidhannagar, Durgapur (near Muchi Para), on Yuri Gagarin Path. The sanctum holds marble statues of Lord Rama and Sita; the carved-stone building is described as one of Durgapur's most beautiful worship centres, with evening sandhya aarti drawing regular crowds. IDENTITY CONFIRMED: multiple listings (Justdial, TripHobo, TripAdvisor) place the same temple at Yuri Gagarin Path, Bidhannagar, Durgapur 713212. Founding date and builder are not documented in any source found (verify).

name: Bidhan Nagar Ram Mandir
town_description: Durgapur is a major industrial city in Paschim Bardhaman district, West Bengal. Bidhan Nagar (Bidhannagar) is a residential township area of Durgapur near Muchi Para, served by the Ram Mandir bus stop on Yuri Gagarin Path.

travel.railway: Durgapur station (~5-6 km); buses/taxis to Bidhan Nagar
travel.road: Yuri Gagarin Path, Bidhannagar, Durgapur 713212; Ram Mandir bus stop on city routes

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; evenings for the sandhya aarti
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-9:00 PM per Justdial; other sources say sunrise to sunset or 6:00-7:30 PM only (verify). Photography is reported prohibited inside the temple complex.
